description: Search jobs: find live job openings from employer career sites and job boards that match what the person wants, by role or keywords, place, remote work, employment type and pay. filters.jobTypes takes FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT or other listed types; any of them match. filters.salaryListedOnly keeps only jobs that post pay. filters.minSalary is annual pay in the requested currency, and ranges that only overlap it are included. Each card carries fit (every applied filter as met, partial, unknown or not_met, and verdict match or near_match: present a near_match as a near match, never as a match; a match meets only the applied filters, so lead stays conditional while unconfirmed names pay, hours, commute or licence, and label is the heading to use), posting (age, freshness, last seen live) and the employer's title and summary as source text. Licence requirements and eligibility remain unassessed. coverage says what was searched and whether more pages exist; an empty or short result covers only this search, not every job. Up to 10 cards a page; page with offset. Each job opens at https://www.metaintro.com/job/<id>.

fallbackToVisitorPlace.description: When the query names no place and the search is not remote, search the signed-in person's saved country, or the country of an anonymous visitor's IP address.

variants.description: Up to 4 more wordings of the same search, such as other job titles for the same work. They run at the same time as query, with the same filters, radius, limit and page, and each counts as one search toward the search limit. Results come back in variants, one entry per wording, leaving out jobs already listed above them; repeatedJobIds names those. Use this instead of separate searches for alternative titles.
